extraction_warnings: Many schema fields (subject_id, sample_id, curator, pmid, subcohort, body_site_details, days_from_first_collection, lifestyle, probing_pocket_depth, probing_pocket_depth_value, ncbi_accession, age, age_unit, ancestry_details, family, family_role) are not reported in the provided text and were marked 'not_reported'.

sequencing_platform was inferred with low confidence since the human metagenomic sequencing is only described generically as 'Illumina platform' without a model name; only the mouse 16S rRNA sequencing explicitly names 'Illumina HiSeq'.

Age, sex distribution, and westernization status are referenced only via supplementary tables (Additional file 1: Table S1) not reproduced in the provided text, so exact values could not be extracted.

The paper is organized around three clinical subgroups (Control, pHTN, HTN) rather than per-sample rows; granularity was set to subgroup_level for fields that vary by group (target_condition, control) and treated as study_level otherwise.
Batch 1 subgroups ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN'] differ from batch 0 ['Control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.
This study does not involve twins, tumors, neonates, or obstetric/gynecologic conditions; most related schema fields are not applicable and marked not_reported.
Detailed clinical parameters (age, BMI, sex ratio) are referenced as being in Additional file 1: Table S1, but the table content was not included in the provided text.

FMT donor/recipient role information exists for both human donors and mouse recipients, but mapping to the human control/pHTN/HTN subgroup structure was not fully feasible; only donor role was captured.
Smoking and antibiotic use fields were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than explicit current-status statements; confidence set to medium.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['Control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.

Schema fields (biomarker_name/unit/value, disease_response_os, ecog_performance_status, tumor_size fields, feces_phenotype_value) appear designed for oncology/clinical trial studies and are largely not applicable to this hypertension/gut microbiome paper; most were marked not_reported.

host_species field is ambiguous given the study includes both human participants and germ-free mice as transplantation recipients; 'Homo sapiens' was selected as the primary host based on the main cohort description, but this may need review if the schema intends to capture the mouse model host as well.
No granular per-sample data table was available in the provided text; all values are study-level or subgroup-level aggregates.
